run_train_model: run fairseq training on one or multiple GPUs using cli_main with a config
run_validate_model: run validation on a subset to evaluate model loss and save checkpoints
run_early_stopping: run early stopping check based on validation loss patience and best metric
run_save_checkpoint: run checkpoint saving at end of epoch or after specified update intervals
run_flatten_config: run config flattening to convert OmegaConf to a plain dictionary for logging
